context:

description:
Found 2026-10-28 while reviewing results.duckdb byte differences. The deploy compares snapshots by canonical content digest (deploy/lib/canonical-digest.ts, deploy/gates/snapshot-digest.ts, from site PR 15). It orders rows by every column, rounds floats to 9 significant digits and drops generated_at. Gaps: (1) the generated_at exclusion now matches no column because core stores only read_model_version in the database (core duckdb_builder.py), so it is dead logic or hides a future column; (2) the digest ignores view and index definitions and column types, and float changes beyond 9 significant digits, although an exact EXCEPT ALL comparison of two core builds showed equal rows, row order and full float precision; (3) deploy/README.md does not explain why the digest is a content digest rather than a byte digest or what it ignores.

Remove the dead exclusion or tie it to a real column, decide whether column types and view definitions belong in the digest (a schema change should change the digest), and add a short section to deploy/README.md that states the invariant and what is ignored.
